body:
I am a 19 yo french male living in Spain, quite interested in psychedelics and psychoactive compounds in general. Before that trip I had previous experiences with Cannabis, Mushrooms, 4-HO/AcO-MET, 4-HO-MiPT, LSD, Methallylescaline, 2C-D, 2C-B-FLY, Salvia Divinorum, Nitrous, DCK, DMXE, MXP, Kratom, Alcohol, Blue Lotus, Nicotine, Khat (Cathinone), Leonurin and Harmin/Harmalin. I always do a lot of research on all compounds (even ones am not interested in taking) and start with low/medium doses, weighed on a calibrated balance (supposedly precise but errors of a few mg are expected). I do not take any side treatment but am a daily weed smoker.
Setting:
I will be alone in my room/garden, my bedroom is a room separated from the main house where the rest of my family stays. They know I am interested in psychoactive compounds and know I do so with care (my parents have had various experiences with psychedelics and still occasionally have some today), I feel very safe in that setting. I have the whole afternoon and night free to myself, so I decided it could be a good day to try a first experience with 3-Me-PCPy (Also last time with a dissociative was a single dose taken more than a month and a half prior to this experience)
Set: I had a nice productive morning, altho I feel a light mental fatigue from waking up early. I have the whole afternoon and night free to myself, so I decided it could be a good day to try for the first time 3-Me-PCPy, I have no tolerance and was curious as this would be my first PCP derivative (altho the base is Roliciclydine aka PCPy, but still same family and 3-Me-PCPy is supposed to be quite different from that one). The day is beautiful and sunny and the very hot summer days are behind us, ideal temperatures. I surely feel a little bit of apprehension knowing the reputation of PCP analogs, but I am confident in the fact that following basic risk reduction practices should enable to avoid most undesirable effects and risks of these substances.
I am quite curious to experiment with the unique characteristics of this substance.
I had a good first experience with the substance and thought I might write a report as they arent many available for the substance. I tried to reduce the risks as much as I could and everything went smoothly but be very sure of what you are doing when exploring, especially with these compounds.
Report:
15pm (T+0:00): I take out my scale and my dissociative safety box (I have a satisfyingly precise balance usually showing a 1mg error range when calibrating. Precisely dosing such low amounts can be complex on a scale and volumetric/geometric dosing is probably better for being sure about dosis. Considering a high dose to be 15-20mg (from what I researched and evaluating my general experience) I felt confident enough in my scale to be sure to take less than that, but any substance dosed even slightly less than these ranges should be dosed in volumetric dosing for extra-safety if you dont have access to a very precise and expensive lab/industrial scale). I weight out a dose until it consistently shows 8mg alone and 11mg with a 1g weight, after 5 consistent measures, as an extra-safe precaution I remove a very small amount (I imagine being 1-2mg) of powder with my spatula. I pour the whole in a gel capsule and gulp it down with water.
15:05pm (T+00:05): The pill got kinda caught in my throat and I it made it pass with a piece of bread. I think the capsule had already dissolved as I felt the chemical taste of M3ppy at the back of my mouth (quite similar to other Arylcyclohexamines I tried and wasnt bothersome). I decide to roll a CBD joint for the beginning and 2 THC joints for later. I often smoke a CBD joint on the come-up of an experience with a substance as I find it helps with challenging physical come-ups, but wont give me as much effects than weed. I play the movie Have a good Trip : Adventures in Psychedelics on Netflix during the weed rolling and coming-up, I usually enjoy the immersion enhancement of dissociatives.
15:20pm (T+00:20): Light increase in sweating, and a subtle feeling of physical stimulation (light enough to be placebo tho). I had lunch not long before the experience which I suppose would delay the come-up.
15:30pm (T+00:30): I dont know if M3ppys anxiolytic effects are already showing up but I fell way less apprehension and a nice mood boost, comforting me in the idea the experience will be enjoyable.
15:40pm (T+00:40): I head out of my bedroom to smoke my CBD j in the garden, while waiting for further effects I keep watching the movie on my computer.
15:50pm (T+00:50): I now feel a light but certain physical euphoria. It feels as if very deep I had a little stimulation of my nerves, felt quite nice altho it was quite subtle. I note a slight increase in cardiac rhythm, but absolutely not bothersome. Quite frequent urination, very alcohol-like, must be the dehydrating effects (read it could also cause difficulty urinating, which I sometimes feel on other substances, tho on that one/that dose I had none of that). I now for sure feel I am off-baseline, I would describe the intensity as a +1 on Shulgin Rating Scale, I could feel being slightly altered but couldnt tell you exactly the nature of the effect if I didnt know the substance.
I could feel being slightly altered but couldnt tell you exactly the nature of the effect if I didnt know the substance.
16:00pm (T+01:00): I suddenly feel like my vision and sense of hearing is upgraded. When I look around details look sharp and clear (especially sharp edges like the sides of the screen or the keyboard) and lights/shadows look very contrasted (looked kind of similar to the HD vision I can get on psychedelics come-ups). For the hearing part, the sounds and voices of the movie felt highly detailed and like I could analyze them separately. The physical euphoria isnt much more developed but a mental stimulation has appeared, it is weak but nice enough to make the small fatigue I felt from waking up early disappear. My thought process seems quite unaltered and somewhat lucid (wouldnt drive but still able to function and think rather normally) altho I do feel an increased capacity of concentration and immersion, and a tendency to be more analytical and introspective.
16:15pm (T+01:15) I stood up to go to the bathroom and felt like my body was light and effortless to move, accompanied by a light spatial disorientation while walking. It was way less difficult to move around then on other aryls like DCK or DMXE as it didnt really have that de-coordination effect making moving such a challenge. The sens of upgraded vision and hearing was still present but didnt develop further than earlier.
16:30pm (T+01:30): The immersion enhancement is pretty obvious, after being very concentrated on the movie, I shifted focus toward introspection and ended up answering to a friend texting me. We chat about how the experience is going so far and psychonautism in general. I am so focused on  the discussion that I forget the movie, that ended several minutes ago. A bit of time distortion as the movie absolutely didnt seem to be as long as I remembered (it had been 1h30 since I started it but that felt like 30-40mins).
16:35pm (T+01:15): I realized the movie had ended just because of the silence that slowly became all-encompassing and very present, it brought me back from my thoughts. I decide to play my Dissociative playlist and put down my phone, see where that brings me. Music sounds great and deep, that sound upgrade I felt earlier makes the music and lyrics clear and euphoric. Colors look a bit saturated especially in red tones. I would pin this point in time as the peak of the more stimulating-physically euphoric effects, entering the 2nd phase of the experience. When focusing on my sensations, I now feel a dissociative effect becoming increasingly present.
16:50pm (T+01:50): I realize its already been quite some time that I am outside, and that the dissociative effects are already developing quickly. I decide to try the interaction with THC before the energetic euphoria subsides. At that stage, the effects of 3-Me-PCPy are present but still quite subtle (I would now consider the intensity to be a +2 -> effects are present and I can feel the different aspects of it but the intensity is very manageable and could be mostly ignored if necessary). At that dose the come-up was very smooth and quite physically relaxing, the stimulation was subtle and clear. I imagine the analgesia of this substance to be quite strong as my sense of touch was very diminished even at that low dose
my sense of touch was very diminished even at that low dose
.
16:55pm (T+01:55): After a few hits on my joint, I put it down and wait a few minutes, not going to get caught off-guard with a too strong synergy. The euphoria induced by music got quite strongly increased and the dissociation also got at level stronger. l can now feel very little sensations of my body when closing my eyes. I still have frequent urination and drink small amounts of water quite regularly to balance the loss of fluids.
17:00pm (T+02:00): Weed is making the dissociation increasingly more present and brings more more of a dissociative headspace to the experience. Music sounds absolutely wonderful and euphoric, it almost feels as sound waves are felt physically. No problem to express thoughts or communicate (at least by texting), at this dose this I wonder if this could be an enjoyable dissociative in a social setting.
17:10pm (T+02:10): Again that nice feeling of body lightness when moving. I must say at that point I feel a certain satisfaction considering I was able to have a nice and interesting experience from a substance of the PCP derivative family, with a minimum of undesirable effects and without feeling any urge to redose. Strengthens my idea that most substance dangers and negative effects can be largely diminished (knowing if you have the ability to set-up such a setting and if the expected positive effects are in fact desirable is another subject).
17:15pm (T+02:15): I would say an ideal dose to fully experience the low-dose effects for me would probably need a few more mg (maybe a 10-15mg dose in oral) but I am very much satisfied with the intensity of the effects for a first time with M3ppy.
17:30pm (T+02:30): Dissociative effects are now the dominant effects of the experience. I can let myself flow in the music with those waves of mental euphoria, as physical sensations were now quite low. I finish my joint and head inside to try drawing on the compound.
17:40pm (T+02:40): Going to the bathroom I stop in front of the mirror, during a few minutes I feel a quite strong dissociation from body and some light perspective distortions. I understand how this substance could be abused in frequency of usage, as you stay quite functional despite quite important euphoria, even at that light dose.
17:50pm (T+02:50): the boost of concentration and creativity is very nice for drawing, combined with the clear stimulation (especially mentally at that stage) making it easy to go through concentrating on details and still having creative ideas to add up. I am quite sure I am already nicely ahead in the plateau, or might even already feel a light diminishing of the effects.
18:30pm (T+03:30): I still very much enjoy the quality it displays for drawing, a nice balance of creativity and productivity, effects are smoothly decreasing.
18:45pm (T+03:45): The come-down is slow and easy, I have a few weird physical and cardiac sensation but they are very short-lived and not disturbing (I am usually quite prone to weird sensations on most substance come-down) altho I imagine in higher dose these could be more uncomfortable. After a while drawing I head back outside to smoke my last joint while the last effects subside and do a quick retrospective of the experience.
19:05pm (T+04:05): I call a friend to share about todays experiment and play a few games during his work-pause. Absolutely no issue in communicating, light mental fatigue. I would say I was completely at baseline an hour later at T+5h
The experience was very interesting for different reasons:
The effects were much more desirable and usable than what PCP and its derivatives are viewed as most people.
The effects were subtle and not overwhelming, very enjoyable and functional as well as having a satisfying long duration.
The effects were more of a high than a full trip but I still personally see a pleasant potential for introspection. The after-effects are nice, I can note a strong anti-depressant and mood-lifting impression, similar to other Aryls after-effects I experienced.
Finally I would still end noting this substance like other of its family is very potent (even at that very low dose I felt considerable effects) and displays high risks of mania states and psychosis in high dosis/redoses, so extra-precautions are to be taken.
First I'd say if you are not very confident in your scale you should absolutely go for volumetric/geometric dosing as doses measured are very low, the substance was also very dehydrating for me so I'd make sure to have access to water during the whole experience.
For frequency of use,
I will personally leave a minimum of a month between each usage before/after using any dissociative or Monoamine releaser but leaving more than that can only be better as we know very little of the long term effects of use (+ In my opinion, dissociative tolerance make their abuse either uninteresting or quickly scarily harsh on the body as increasingly strong doses are required to reach effects).
3-Me-PCPy had a nice and pleasant synergy with cannabis, but I have quite a strong tolerance and usually have very little negative effects even in combinations (careful with increased risks of mania and psychosis). I would say for me the effects are strong enough by themselves to try a combination with something else than weed but
MAOI, an SSRI or any monoamine releaser, as this could quickly cause a Serotonin Syndrome.
Thanks for reading that long TR on a quite obscure substance and stay safe.
